Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate meetings and events. Our AI doesn't just assist planners – it does the work. It emails and calls venues, negotiates rates in 22 languages, parses 50-page hotel proposals into clean apples-to-apples comparisons, and surfaces unmanaged meeting spend across your entire org.

We work with companies ranging from ones planning one epic company kickoff a year to ones running thousands of meetings through the platform annually. Clients include Google, Airbnb, BlackRock, Anthropic, Pylon, and Mintlify.

Unlike legacy platforms like Cvent that bolted AI onto decades-old infrastructure, Nowadays was built from the ground up for the AI era.

launches.title: Nowadays AI: AI-Native Platform for Corporate Meetings & Events
launches.tagline: The AI-native platform that sources venues, negotiates contracts, and runs your entire corporate event, so your team just shows up
launches.body:
Hey everyone!! We're Anna and Amy, sisters, co-founders, and the people who used to manually call 20 hotels for a single offsite.

We launched Nowadays on YC S23 as an "AI copilot for event planning." Two years later, we want to show you what we actually built :)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/709549e5-8a04-4b5c-8557-76886ff145a0)

# **TL;DR**

Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate retreats and meetings. Tell us what you need: we handle venue sourcing, contract negotiation, room blocks, attendee logistics, and post-event reconciliation. Fortune 500 teams and fast-growing startups use Nowadays to run offsites they're proud of, without burning out their ops team.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/53908cc7-1f81-4c15-afe7-5e0f11b7ad59)

# **The Problem**

Planning a corporate offsite is a second job nobody signed up for.

Your EA or ops lead spends weeks cold-emailing hotels, chasing RFPs, deciphering hotel contracts, and manually tracking room blocks in spreadsheets, only to do it all over again next quarter.

The vendors in this space are slow and expensive. Many of our customers have said the same thing: "I got paired with a planner worse than myself."

The result: overpriced venues, cancellation penalties nobody caught, and an ops team that's exhausted before the event even starts. And for most enterprises, 65% of meeting spend is completely unmanaged, buried in expense reports, booked by admins outside any system.

# **Our Solution**

Nowadays replaces the entire event planning stack with one AI-native platform, backed by a team that actually executes on your behalf. You tell us what you need. We handle the rest. Your team just shows up.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/67abf2bb-7640-4684-9bbf-c2bfb3a85d4a)

## **1. AI-powered venue sourcing**

Describe your event, dates, headcount, vibe, budget, and we generate a curated shortlist of venues with proposals in 24 hours, not weeks. We have relationships with 400K+ hotels globally and we're a certified IATA travel agency.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/cedeb56d-e591-4eed-a1f6-b75d1eabf9b5)

## **2. Contract negotiation, handled**

We negotiate directly with venues on your behalf, pushing on room rates, F&B minimums, attrition clauses, and cancellation terms. Our AI knows market rates from thousands of events and pushes back when hotels overcharge. Clients routinely save 20-30% vs. going direct.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/1156b34d-e9b9-4e1d-bc9a-7736a13901a9)

## **3. Exclusive rates**

We aggregate demand across all our clients to secure rates individual companies can't get on their own.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/592bb426-c3e7-4457-ab13-860504f2fc0e)

## **4. End-to-end logistics**

Room blocks, cutoff dates, rooming lists, supplier coordination, tracked in one place, managed by us. Nothing falls through the cracks while you're onsite.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/49563edb-1c99-4cc1-afbd-d590b691258f)

## **5. Attendee registration and logistics**

Custom registration forms, dietary needs, t-shirt sizes, room assignments, all in the platform. Your ops lead is not managing 12 spreadsheets.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/302d0f5a-5d1c-4b01-8cdc-32bffe7d01e8)

## **6. Expert support**

Every client gets a dedicated Nowadays partner who knows your program, your preferences, and your budget. Our AI acts, and when you need a human, we're there.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/2afea73a-7a20-4209-b1b7-e2ded68d6a13)

## **7. Post-event reconciliation**

We audit the final folio, catch billing errors, and close the loop financially. No more surprise charges two weeks after everyone's home.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/836fcdff-8837-4754-b447-cda95c651c11)

## **Why we're different**

Every competitor you've heard of bolted AI onto infrastructure built decades ago. We built around AI from day one, which is why a small team can do at scale what legacy platforms need armies of account managers to do.

Our AI calls venues in 22 languages, parses 50-page proposals into clean apples-to-apples comparisons, and routes every meeting through approval workflows, including the small ones EAs used to book on their own.

One Fortune 500 VP uncovered $18M in previously unmanaged meeting spend just by turning Nowadays on.

# **Use Cases**

* Quarterly offsites: for remote-first teams who need to meet all their new employees
* Leadership retreats: for executive teams running strategic planning sessions
* Sales kickoffs: with complex AV, F&B, and multi-day programming needs
* International group travel: we handle the complexity of multi-country logistics end to end

# **Where We Are Now**

We work with companies ranging from ones planning one epic kickoff a year to ones running thousands of meetings through the platform annually. Clients include Google, Airbnb, BlackRock, Anthropic, Pylon, and Mintlify.

We've run retreats from San Diego to Thailand, from 20-person leadership offsites to 500+ person company kickoffs.

We won both judges' choice and people's choice at Business Travel Show America 2025 and Business Travel Show APAC 2026, the two biggest innovation competitions in corporate travel.

# **Why Now**

Corporate travel spend is back and growing. But the infrastructure for planning events hasn't caught up. Legacy travel companies are slow, opaque, and not built for the modern distributed workforce. We're rebuilding this from scratch with AI at the core and a team that treats every event like it's our own.

# **We're growing!!**

We're hiring across the board for founding team members, engineers, operators, and account executives who want to work on a problem that's genuinely hard and unsolved, with a really fun team in San Francisco.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/6174eee6-ebce-4c88-8465-b443a7584c55)

See open roles: [nowadays.ai/careers](https://nowadays.ai/careers)

# **Get started**

Book a call: [meetings-na2.hubspot.com/amy-yan](http://meetings-na2.hubspot.com/amy-yan)

Email us: [events@nowadays.ai](mailto:events@nowadays.ai)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/ee979b76-ff7a-42cc-99f8-18f3034a7d95)

launches.body:
Hi everyone! We’re Anna and Amy, sisters and co-founders of [Nowadays](https://www.getnowadays.com/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73488&key=user_uploads/1374367/8abc167e-68ed-4057-ab7a-4f39e5f961ec)

_From left to right:_

[Anna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/annasun19): Software engineer from MIT, with PM & SWE experiences at DoorDash, Amazon, and Datadog. Organized events for 1300+ students as class president at MIT.

[Amy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amysunyan/): 7+ years in strategy & operations roles at Google, Meta, and McKinsey. Organized events for 2000+ students as class president at Johns Hopkins.

### **🧨 The Problem**

Corporate event planners are bombarded with endless calls and emails while planning events. Stressing over tight schedules, planners are paying for full-time assistants or tools that cost them $100,000+ a year.

What if we could transform this time-consuming and expensive process, making it not just simple, but enjoyable and efficient?

### **🙌🏼 The Solution**

Meet [Nowadays](http://getnowadays.com/), the first AI co-pilot for event planning. Recover hours lost to manual, repetitive tasks, and spend time focusing on what really matters.

**Here’s how it works:** Share event details, and we'll automatically reach out to venues and vendors, manage emails and calls, and stay within budget.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73488&key=user_uploads/1347384/482a0ef3-b7e2-4569-bd63-3e15548b608d)

_Want a venue with an onsite golf course? Done ✅_

_Activities within walking distance? Booked ✅_

_Keeping your costs under a certain budget? You got it ✅_

But that’s not all. Our AI doesn't just offer a one-size-fits-all approach. It adapts to unique tastes and needs, providing a truly personalized event planning experience.

We're not just offering a tool; we're offering a smarter way to celebrate, connect, and create unforgettable moments.

### **👋 Ask: How you can help**

1. Know anyone planning corporate events (e.g. retreats, happy hours, holiday parties)? We’d love to speak to any event planners, office managers, or executive assistants about their day-to-day experiences. Send any leads to [founders@getnowadays.com](mailto:founders@getnowadays.com). 🙏
2. Follow along on our journey [here](https://www.linkedin.com/company/getnowadays/)!

### Transform the way you plan events with **Nowadays** **🚀**
